purpose: Restaurants still missing publishable hours after source review

restaurants.name: Beans of Eden
restaurants.notes: Two dated snapshots of the same directory give daily 7 AM–8 PM and 8 AM–8 PM. Cannery Row confirms the address without hours. Call the listed cafe number (831) 215-6209 to confirm current opening time. Live Google Maps at the exact address shows Mon–Thu 7 AM–6 PM and Fri–Sun 7 AM–8 PM. The conflicting Roadtrippers snapshots did not show that day split, and no second source has confirmed it.

restaurants.name: Paper Wing Theatre & Supper Club
restaurants.notes: The theater advertises specific shows and ticketed dining events. The Chamber's Mon–Fri 10 AM–5 PM applies to its office, and its Thu–Mon 4–10 PM listing applies to a separate sushi walk-up window. Call (831) 905-5684 for the event's meal service time or to confirm any regular dining hours. The current theater calendar directs visitors to individual showtimes. The VIP Dinner Package page confirms that dinner can be part of a particular ticket.

restaurants.name: Domenico's Fish Market and Deli
restaurants.notes: The Wharf Association lists the market and deli separately without hours. Domenico's site explicitly gives daily 11:30 AM to close for the dining room only. Call (831) 372-3655 for separate market counter hours.

restaurants.name: Kuma Sushi
restaurants.notes: Google Maps lists daily 5–10 PM at 414 Alvarado St with the same 831-324-4745 phone as Old Monterey's merchant directory. Restaurantji and Wanderlog match. The Chamber lists a different schedule (Tue–Thu 4:30–9 PM, Fri–Sat 4:30–9:30 PM and Sun 1–7 PM) and contact number. Its linked site could not be reached. Kuma's Wix menu shows no hours, Instagram requires sign-in and its ordering page shows a separate split schedule. Call 831-324-4745 to resolve the dine-in schedule. Google Maps evidence: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Sushi+Kuma/@36.5995793,-121.8946533,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x808de5ca6361c5af:0xecb2a100fa17c12f!8m2!3d36.5995793!4d-121.8946533!16s%2Fg%2F11qypjdnc2?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MTEwMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D

restaurants.name: Benny Walker's
restaurants.notes: Soft-opening hours reported as daily 4–8 PM at 444 Alvarado St, with longer 11 AM–10:30 PM hours possible as soon as Nov 11. Downtown association lists the venue but no standing schedule. Confirm the post-soft-opening schedule with the operator. The downtown association lists the operator’s Instagram but no phone number or permanent hours.

restaurants.name: Compact Disco — EAT takeout window
restaurants.notes: Compact Disco’s June announcement gives a 2 AM close for the all-ages walk-up window at 420 Tyler Street on Friday and Saturday nights. Edible Monterey Bay reported 10 PM–2 AM on those nights in June. Later operator social posts describe different opening hours for the 21+ pub kitchen. The current downtown association listing confirms the window exists at 420 Tyler Street but omits hours. Confirm the current takeout window schedule separately from club, happy-hour and in-pub kitchen hours. See Monterey lists the venue phone as (831) 920-2518. Ask specifically for the all-ages EAT window. Uber Eats lists the same-address food menu for delivery but provides no current schedule for the physical walk-up window.

restaurants.name: Whole Foods Market — Prepared Foods
restaurants.notes: Call (831) 333-1600 for the Prepared Foods counter and hot bar. The location page confirms the hot bar but publishes only supermarket hours. Counter service may run on a different schedule. The location page’s embedded listing data describes the Hot Bar as an amenity without separate hours. Monterey’s Market Cocina and Market Sandwich each have a provisional daily 9 AM–8 PM lead in public listings. Waze also lists Market Cocina at those hours. The public listings may share an upstream source. Whole Foods lists both counters separately from the Hot Bar and publishes no hours for any of the three. Confirm the named counter and hot bar hours separately.
